content: Current Scrapling docs describe SiteToMarkdownSpider with required allowed_domains, page-to-Markdown items, robots compliance, concurrency/autothrottle, and link rules; its max_pages limits converted pages but already-queued requests may still be fetched. Spider architecture says robots-denied requests are silently dropped, and blocked requests are retried. Docs accessed 2026-10-01; API details should be rechecked against the pinned release.
